# Vendored front-end libraries

Copied unmodified from the npm registry so the demo UI has no runtime CDN dependency.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `vega.min.js` | vega@5.30.0 (`build/vega.min.js`) | BSD-3-Clause |
| `vega-lite.min.js` | vega-lite@5.21.0 (`build/vega-lite.min.js`) | BSD-3-Clause |
| `vega-embed.min.js` | vega-embed@6.26.0 (`build/vega-embed.min.js`) | BSD-3-Clause |
| `vis-network.min.js` | vis-network@9.1.9 (`standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js`) | Apache-2.0 OR MIT |
| `world-110m.json` | vega-datasets@2.8.0 (`data/world-110m.json`, Natural Earth via world-atlas) | BSD-3-Clause (data: public domain) |

Refresh with `npm pack <pkg>@<version>` and copy the same paths.
